title: arctostaphylos nummularia var. sensitiva
intro: Arctostaphylos nummularia var. sensitiva, commonly known as sensitive manzanita, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly by the indigenous communities of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, where it is valued for its medicinal properties and used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of sensitive manzanita include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-hypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
